author: ALM
body:
Hi,

I was banned for hacking a few months ago and decided to step away due to personal reasons.
I am now back and wish to appeal the ban, I feel that through these last months I have grown wiser and will not complete the same task again.

Thanks,
ALM

title: ALM's Ban Appeal

replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body:
Hello ALM,

Since the evidence has been many months old and that you have been banned for a fair amount of time we have decided to appeal your infraction. Do not let it happen again and welcome back to the network. Your appeal is accepted.

Regards,
GrapeSmoothie, Senior Moderator
